```{r}
library(powertools)
library(tidyverse)
```


Holmes, L., Neagu, M., Sanders-Ellis, D., & Harrison, N. (2020). Lifelong Links evaluation report. Department for Education. https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/955953/Lifelong_Links_evaluation_report.pdf

Page 39 -- participation by trial site:

```{r}
completed <- data.frame(
  completed_plan_without_fgc = c(1, 1, 13, 35, 51, 4, 1, 0, 14, 0, 3),
  completed_fgc = c(1, 1, 26, 10, 45, 3, 1, 0, 12, 0, 3)
) |>
  mutate(completed_sum = completed_plan_without_fgc + completed_fgc) |>
  filter(completed_sum > 0)

completed_CYP <- completed$completed_sum
twice_completed <- completed_CYP * 2
```


Total for intervention and control:

```{r}
mean(twice_completed)
sd(twice_completed)
```

```{r}
completed |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = completed_sum) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20)
```



```{r}
n_per_LA <- mean(completed_CYP)
LAs <- multisite.cont(
  delta    = 0.2,
  sd       = 1,
  m.sd     = sd(twice_completed),
  m        = mean(twice_completed),
  power    = .8,
  Rsq      = sqrt(0.7),
  alpha    = 0.05,
  icc0     = 0.05,
  icc1     = 0.05,
  sides    = 2
) |> ceiling()
LAs
n_per_LA * LAs
```


Test with one site:

```{r}
test_delta = 0.42
test_m = 1
test_sites <- multisite.cont(
  delta = test_delta,
  sd = 1,
  m.sd = 0,
  m = test_m,
  power = .8,
  Rsq = 0,
  alpha = 0.05,
  icc0 = 0,
  icc1 = 0,
  sides = 2
)
cat("multisite.cont: ")
ceiling(test_m * test_sites) |> cat()
cat("\npower.t.test:   ")
(power.t.test(delta = test_delta, power = 0.8, sig.level = 0.05)$n * 2) |> ceiling() |> cat()
```
